info.title: Hive Daemon API
info.description: Local administrator API, including the explicit peer gateway. Health is anonymous; protected routes require the local administrator bearer. The optional separate peer listener accepts scoped peer bearers and exposes only the session/turn inspection and control subset documented in docs/daemon-peering.md.

EditMessageRequest.description: Replace a user or assistant message in a new fork, discarding its suffix.

ErrorResponse.description: Safe structured error returned by public API endpoints.

full_context.description: Use the model's full window; absent inherits the session's opt-in.

HealthResponse.description: Daemon identity and advertised capabilities, independent of any client UI.

messages.description:
Atomically accept prompts already submitted by the client, including
requests whose HTTP acknowledgement has not arrived yet.

turn_id.description:
Pin cancellation to the run the client saw, so a late request cannot
cancel its successor. Omit to interrupt the current run.

LoginResponse.description: The URL is an ephemeral authorization link, never an access token.

model.description: Provider-reported model when available, otherwise the selected model ID.

provider.description: Provider selected for this message's turn or originating model request.

max_children.description:
Maximum concurrently outstanding direct children (queued, active, or paused).
Aggregate operation budgets remain the cumulative lifetime bound.

max_concurrent_children.description: Maximum simultaneously running direct children; queued children use max_children.

max_depth.description: Remaining delegation depth; a leaf has no orchestration policy.
